agentFarm.insightAutoDelegate.markdownDescription: Insight categories **handed to the insight's own agent** as a headless task when they appear: warnings and errors only, once a day per problem, queued by the task-runner window. Empty = off. Example: `["memory-index", "duties", "guardrail"]`; every row in Insights shows its category. This spends agent time.

agentFarm.qualitySample.description: Sample recent session outputs and score them 1–5 with the cheap-model judge, on a schedule; a small API cost per sample. Run one by hand with Sample Output Quality Now.

agentFarm.qualitySamplesPerAgent.description: How many not-yet-scored recent sessions per agent each quality sampling run scores.

agentFarm.suggestScan.description: Weekly cheap-model scan of your follow-up messages for repeated corrections, proposing CLAUDE.md rules (Insights view). Manual: 'Scan for Instruction Suggestions…'.

agentFarm.weeklySummary.description: Once per ISO week, a three-sentence fleet summary by a cheap model, as a notification and, when set, in the automatic reports folder.

agentFarm.queueAutoAdvance.description: When a task finishes successfully, start the same agent's next queued task.

agentFarm.autoReport.description: Write a fleet report into the automatic reports folder (checked hourly while VS Code is open).

agentFarm.autoReportFolder.description: Folder for automatic fleet reports (e.g. a folder inside your Obsidian vault).

agentFarm.autoReportDays.description: Period (in days) covered by automatic fleet reports.

agentFarm.trendAlertFactor.description: Warn when an agent's cost over seven days reaches this multiple of the seven days before. 0 = off.

agentFarm.costAnomalyMinUsd.description: Days spending less than this are left out of the cost anomaly check. 0 turns the check off.

enumDescriptions: Token count, e.g. "123.4k tok today"
Dollar cost, e.g. "$12.34 today"
agentFarm.agentRowCostUnit.description: What the daily usage on each agent's row in the Agents view counts. Tokens by default, since cost reads $0 until a Model prices rule matches the model.

agentFarm.evalRunArgs.description: CLI arguments for eval-set replay calls. Keep a cheap model for routine regression checks; empty = the agent's default model (more faithful, more expensive).

agentFarm.autoReportIncludeOutputs.description: Append the archived task-outputs digest to automatic fleet reports.

agentFarm.budgets.description: Daily budgets in dollars by agent name (API-equivalent value); "*" is the whole fleet. Example: {"agent_one": 20, "*": 50}. It warns at 80% and alerts when one is passed. A figure of 0 means NO CAP on that name, so {"*": 0} lifts the fleet ceiling while per-agent figures stay. Ignore all budgets turns them all off at once.

agentFarm.budgetsUnlimited.description: Suspend every daily budget: while on, no agent has a cap and nothing warns or blocks on spend, whatever Daily budgets says. The figures are kept, not cleared; turn it off and they are back in force.

agentFarm.includeUnmatchedProjects.description: Also include sessions whose working directory is outside the configured agent roots (shown under 'Other projects'). Applies to every engine — a Codex or Antigravity conversation in a stray folder is governed by this switch exactly like a Claude one.

agentFarm.pricing.description: Model pricing rules in USD per million tokens. First regex match wins.

match.description: Regular expression tested against the model id. The FIRST rule that matches wins, so put the narrow ones above the broad ones.

cacheWrite.description: USD per million tokens written to the prompt cache (Anthropic bills this above the input rate).

cacheRead.description: USD per million tokens read back from the prompt cache — the cheapest of the four, and usually the largest count.

agentFarm.livingChecks.description: Living page checks. Each entry is {label, when:{kind,path,except,minCount,hours,recursive}, level:info|warn|alert, hint?}. The precondition is read as "TRUE = needs attention" - e.g. kind:fileMissing on today's diary file, or kind:folderHasFiles on an inbox that should be empty. Paths support {today} / {yesterday}.

label.description: The loop being checked, in your own words - it is the row's title on the Living page ("today's diary was written").

when.description: The precondition, read as TRUE = needs attention. {kind, path, except, minCount, hours, recursive}. kind is one of folderHasFiles | fileMissing | pathChangedWithin | queueHasWork; path supports the {today} and {yesterday} tokens; except lists file names that do not count as work; minCount defaults to 1; hours is the window for pathChangedWithin; recursive looks into sub-folders (folderHasFiles).

level.description: How loud the row is when the check hits. Default: warn.

hint.description: What closes the loop - the one line the reader acts on.

detail.description: Shown instead of the raw precondition detail when the check hits.

okDetail.description: Text for the healthy case. Empty = the precondition's own detail.

agentFarm.superpowersPath.description: The folder holding the Superpowers skills: one folder per skill with its SKILL.md, plus using-superpowers/SKILL.md, the hook. Nothing is loaded by default; only the hook is given to a session with Superpowers on. %USERPROFILE%, ~, $HOME, ${env:VAR} and ${workspaceRoot} expand. Empty = _SKILLS/superpowers beside your agents.

agentFarm.superpowersDefaults.markdownDescription: Which agents start a session with Superpowers on, by agent name: `{ "developer": true, "asistan": false }`. The switch itself is per session, beside the project chip above the composer; this is only where it starts. An agent not named here follows the built-in list: `developer` on, the rest off.

agentFarm.wikiRoot.description: The folder that holds the wiki: one folder per category, a page per concept, plus index.md, log.md and the wiki's rules file. Portable: %USERPROFILE%, ~, $HOME, ${env:VAR} and ${workspaceRoot} are expanded when it is opened, so the same settings work on another machine. Empty = D:\zone\know\note\obsidian\00_WIKI.

agentFarm.wikiAgent.description: Which agent writes the wiki: a compile runs under this agent unless the call names one. Empty = the first agent the farm knows.

enumDescriptions: Not set: Claude Code.
Anthropic's Claude Code.
OpenAI's Codex.
Google's Gemini CLI.
Antigravity.
OpenCode, each model on its own provider.
agentFarm.wikiEngine.description: Which engine a wiki compile runs on when the call names none. Empty = Claude Code. A compile reads whole transcripts and writes pages, so choose it deliberately.

agentFarm.wikiModel.description: The model a wiki compile runs on (alias or full id) when the call names none. Empty = the agent's own default. Synthesis is the costly half of the wiki: a capable model pays here.

enumDescriptions: Not set: no effort flag is passed.
Quick, light thinking.
Balanced.
Deeper thinking, more tokens.
Deeper still.
The most thinking the model allows.
agentFarm.wikiEffort.description: The effort a wiki compile runs at when the call names none. Empty = none.

agentFarm.projectsRoot.description: Folder that holds your project folders. A new project is offered a folder inside it, and Rescan Project Folders walks it. Leave empty to choose a folder by hand for every project.

agentFarm.projectSkeleton.description: What a new project folder is built from. Empty = the built-in layout: Charter, Plan, Backlog, Backloglog, People, Worklog and the numbered folders. A path ending in / is a folder; {project} {id} {status} {date} {yymmdd} expand; role finds a document, never its file name; holds finds a folder.

path.description: path inside the project folder; a trailing / means a folder

role.description: what this document IS — how Agent Farm finds it, whatever it is called

holds.description: what this FOLDER is for, when it cannot be found by a role: decisions (one file each) or tracks (the backlog track ledger)

template.description: initial content; the placeholders above expand

agentFarm.projectsArchiveRoot.description: Where an archived project's folder is moved. Empty = beside the projects folder: <parent>/99_ARCHIVE/<name>_ARCHIVE. Archiving is always its own confirmed action: it shows both paths first, never lands on a folder that exists, and Restore moves it back.

agentFarm.projectTemplates.description: Project shapes to start a new project from, saved off one that already proved itself (Save as Template on its page asks what travels). Each entry: {name, description?, kind?, status?, summary?, tags?, repos?, agents?, budgetUSD?, budgetTotalUSD?, color?, icon?, people?, plan?, backlog?, skeleton?}. Never an id, a folder or a parent.

name.description: how it is picked, and its identity in this list

description.description: one line, shown next to the name in the picker

agentFarm.projectStaleDays.description: Days of silence after which a project still marked active is flagged as quiet. 0 turns the check off. A project list without this becomes a graveyard nobody dares tidy.

agentFarm.projectDigestDay.description: The weekday each open project's weekly digest is posted on (0 Sunday … 6 Saturday); -1 is off. The summary lands on Notices with the full report attached and the project stamped, so it also shows on that project's Work tab and timeline. Posted once per project per week.

agentFarm.projectDigestHour.description: The hour (local) after which the weekly project digest may be posted. It exists so a Monday digest is not written at 00:05 about a week that, in your head, ended eight hours ago.

agentFarm.projectContextExtra.description: One line of your own added to the context every session started in a project gets (the ◧ chip above the Console composer), for example a pointer to your own rules. Empty by default.

agentFarm.noticeStaleHours.description: Hours after which an UNREAD level-3+ notice counts as ignored: it escalates on the Living page and in the status bar. A board nobody reads is the same as one nobody wrote to.

agentFarm.idleSessionNoticeMinutes.markdownDescription: The **"‹agent› is waiting for you"** reminder on the **Notices** page, posted once when a session has waited this long for your input. **0 turns it off.** The corner box of the same name is "Notify on Console turn end".

agentFarm.consoleDropZone.description: Whether the Console page listens for a file dropped anywhere on it. Turn this off if drag-and-drop misbehaves on your machine; 📎 (Attach) and pasting a screenshot are unaffected either way.

agentFarm.handoverSources.markdownDescription: Where a sentry campaign looks for the handover note of the session that just ended, in order. Empty = all four: transcript (the files that session itself wrote), configured (Handover folders), projectNotes (the project's 10_Notes) and fallback. A file is matched by its name and who wrote it, and another session's note is never adopted.

agentFarm.handoverFolders.markdownDescription: The folders the configured source looks in, in order. They take the same path variables as Reports folder; a template whose variable has nothing behind it on this machine is skipped, with its reason. Empty = Answers folder, then `${vault}/00_AGENT_AREA/00_OUTPUT/01_CEVAPLAR`.

agentFarm.sentryTemplatesFile.description: A markdown file with your own words a sentry campaign starts the next session with. Shaped like Saved prompts: a heading names the verdict (item-done, clean-handover, nothing-to-continue, hit-the-wall, or * for any) and only fenced text is used. A verdict you do not write keeps its built-in words. It is read before Instruction files.

agentFarm.sentryInstructionFiles.markdownDescription: Your own saved instructions a sentry campaign draws on, as an ordered list of markdown files (path variables allowed). Shaped like Saved prompts: a block whose heading names a verdict fills mechanically as a template, and every block is material the leader blends into the next session's opening words. Empty is normal.

agentFarm.sentryLeaderEngine.markdownDescription: The engine a sentry leader turn runs on when the campaign names none. An engine that cannot be run and read this way is refused by name rather than replaced. Empty = Claude Code.

agentFarm.sentryLeaderModel.markdownDescription: The model a sentry leader turn runs on. The leader is woken only when one of the campaign's own conditions fires, and gets one short turn to write the next session's opening words. Cheap on purpose; raise it deliberately, with Leader daily budget in mind. Empty = haiku.

agentFarm.sentryLeaderBudgetUsd.markdownDescription: What one campaign's leader turns may spend per calendar day. When it is gone the campaign does not stop: it carries on mechanically, filling templates, and you are told once on Notices. 0 = no daily budget.

agentFarm.sentryLeaderMaxSeconds.markdownDescription: How long one leader turn may take before it is cut; a cut turn falls back to the template and is recorded as a fault.

agentFarm.sentryLeaderMaxUsd.markdownDescription: What one leader turn may cost. A turn that goes over is still used, since it is paid for either way, but the next one is refused and the campaign runs mechanically until tomorrow.

agentFarm.sentryLeaderFailLimit.markdownDescription: Failed leader turns in a row after which the campaign drops to the mechanical path and says so. 0 = off, as for Barren rounds allowed.

agentFarm.sentryFailureLimit.description: How many barren rounds in a row switch a sentry campaign off. A round is barren when the run failed, or succeeded and left nothing behind. It is an alarm for a broken setup opening empty sessions all night, not a round budget; the first round that achieves something clears it. 0 = off.

agentFarm.sentryIdlePollMin.description: How often an idling sentry campaign looks at the backlog again, so an item you write tomorrow morning is noticed. It does not apply while a round is running, and never shortens a measured wait such as a quota wall.

agentFarm.sentryStallMin.description: How long a sentry round may say nothing before the watchdog ends it, typically a session stuck on a permission prompt nobody is there to answer. Silence is measured from the run's own output, so a thinking turn is never touched. The round ends as failed and is not retried. 0 = off.

agentFarm.sessionBreakMin.description: How long a pause between two turns runs before the session counts as put down rather than thinking. That stretch is taken off the Duration column, so a conversation resumed the next morning is not a day and a half long; a long turn is the work itself and is never taken off. 0 = Duration runs from first message to last.

agentFarm.promptSnippetsFile.description: The markdown file holding the phrases you send to agents again and again. Only text inside ``` fences is offered; everything around it is your own notes. Right-click a Send or Start button in the Console to paste one. Empty = a built-in path in the vault, while that file exists.
